info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Enterprise Services Legal Advisory By Legal Advisory Id-v5-spec
info.description: The Legal Advisory Update API facilitates the modification of existing legal advisory services within the banking enterprise system. This endpoint allows authorized users to patch specific attributes of a legal advisory record identified by its unique ID. Typical consumers include legal teams and banking administrators who require dynamic adjustments to compliance documents or advisory details. This API ensures that legal advisories stay current and relevant to operational needs, thus supporting risk management and regulatory compliance.
